title: The Hidden Costs of Forgetting: trajectory deletion in SE agents (Vallecillos-Ruiz, Bouzenia, Pradel, Moonen)
finding: 42 deletion configs, 9400 runs: flat pricing 26/42 cheaper; cache-aware (read 0.1x, ignores write premium) 0/42 cheaper, lowest delayed ratio ~1.03; immediate deletion hurts solve rate, 2-turn delay keeps it; refetch up to 1.2-4.6x for tool-output deletion
limitation: one open-weight model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash), SWE-bench; one run per config; random deletion; batching NOT tested; write premium ignored (so real cost higher)

title: The Physical Cost of Context: quality-constrained resource accounting for coding agents (Yu et al.)
finding: Mask-5 (sliding window) cut prompt tokens 33% but fresh prefill +608%, time +37%, failed quality gate (29->26 solved); single anchored rewrite (Compact) ~neutral; break-even masking hurts when hit rate >~0.55
limitation: local GPU, open-weight, token/energy not dollars, 100 tasks

title: TokenPilot: Cache-Efficient Context Management (Xu et al.)
finding: batch-turn eviction every B turns; B=3 best of {1,3,5,7,9,inf}; B=1 raises misses; cost -56 to -87% vs vanilla with GPT-5.4-mini hit/miss pricing; accuracy mixed (Claw-Eval -1.4 to -2.6)
limitation: PinchBench/Claw-Eval not AppWorld; page ambiguous on B vs tracking window 33; tool-schema churn lowers reuse noted; no write premium in pricing

title: Cache Engineering for Agents (Fu et al.)
finding: argues trimming/summarising invalidates cache; tool-response rolling drop -27.7% cost vs threshold summarisation with AKV engine (needs self-hosted serving)
limitation: requires KV-level control, not available on commercial APIs

title: Token Reduction Is Not Cost Reduction (Weinberger, Hozez)
finding: tool-output compression -38% tokens -> +6.8% bill; cache write+read ~80% of bill, tool outputs ~3.3%; r=0.15; extra turns offset savings
limitation: Claude Code, ~38-45 eff tasks/arm, high baseline success, tool outputs only

title: Cache-Aware Prompt Compression: two-tier cost model (Y. Song)
finding: query-aware compression of the cached prefix +40% on tau-bench; query-agnostic stable compressed prefix cheapest; break-even compression r>=6 for query-aware; hit-rate plateau ~0.83-0.89
limitation: compresses wiki/system block not history; single model; 50 tasks; v1

title: Don't Break the Cache (Lumer et al.)
finding: caching saves 41-80% cost on DeepResearch Bench across OpenAI/Anthropic/Google; system-prompt caching gives most savings; changing tool defs invalidates prefix; excluding tool results from cache similar savings
limitation: one benchmark, 40 sessions/cond; ablation varies tool calls not tool defs

title: The Complexity Trap (Lindenbauer et al.)
finding: masking (M=10) ~halves cost vs raw with equal solve rate on SWE-bench Verified; cost ignores/loosely models cache (Qwen priced w/o hit distinction); LLM summary lengthens trajectories 13-15%
applicability: high for accuracy, low for billed cost
limitation: SWE-agent only, cost not cache-priced

title: AgentDiet / Reducing Cost of LLM Agents with Trajectory Reduction (Xiao et al.)
finding: delayed reduction of step s-a (a=2) keeps earlier prefix; input tokens -40-60%, cost -21 to -36% with cache READ discount, pass rate -1.0..+2.0; cache-write ignored; reflection overhead 5-10%
limitation: Trae Agent, 2 LLMs; cost estimated; cache write not priced

title: ACON: Optimizing Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents (Kang et al., Microsoft)
finding: AppWorld gpt-4.1 168 tasks: no compression 56.0% 9.93k peak $0.331/task; ACON history 56.5% 7.33k $0.285 latency +20%; naive baselines FIFO 45.8, LLMLingua 39.3; appendix concedes history compression invalidates KV cache
limitation: cost list-price w/o stated cache accounting; GPT only; compressor extra call

title: Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) (Zhang et al.)
finding: AppWorld ReAct 42.4 -> 59.4 avg with evolving playbook (DeepSeek-V3.1); longer contexts but 91.8% input from prompt cache (GPT-5.1) -> -82.6% billed input; context pollution risk w/o reliable feedback
limitation: playbook is append/delta -> cache-friendly only if stable; offline adaptation uses train split

title: Anthropic docs: context editing
finding: clear_tool_uses trigger/keep/clear_at_least; "clearing invalidates cached prefixes... use clear_at_least"; thinking clearing invalidates cache except Claude 5.1+
limitation: no cost numbers

title: Anthropic cookbook: context engineering tools
finding: single-run synthetic demo; clearing peak 173k vs baseline 335k; memory session 2 halves file reads; compaction lost 3/3 obscure facts; must sum cache_creation+cache_read tokens
limitation: n=1 synthetic

title: Anthropic blog: context management (29%/39%/84%)
finding: +29% (editing), +39% (editing+memory) on internal agentic search eval; -84% tokens in 100-turn web search; baseline undefined; no cost-with-cache figure
limitation: no n, CI, model or cache accounting

title: Anthropic prompt caching docs
finding: prefix order tools->system->messages; write 1.25x/2x, read 0.1x (0.05x Opus5.5/Sonnet5.5); tool-def change invalidates all; 20-block lookback; inline-tools beta (mid-conversation tool addition without editing tools)
limitation: read 100k of 164k

title: OpenAI prompt caching docs
finding: GPT-5.6+: read 0.1x, write 1.25x (30m) ; earlier models no write charge; rewriting/summarising history, compaction, tool list changes break prefix; allowed_tools keeps prefix
limitation: pricing differs by model generation

title: Manus: Context Engineering for AI Agents
finding: KV hit rate key metric; 100:1 input:output; append-only; mask logits not remove tools; restorable compression via files
limitation: anecdotal, few numbers

title: Context Length Alone Hurts LLM Performance Despite Perfect Retrieval (Du et al.)
venue_date: arXiv 2025-10 (EMNLP findings per listing not verified)
finding: 13.9-85% accuracy drop with length alone, even masked; recitation helps
limitation: synthetic long inputs 5 models, not agent loops

title: LLMs Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation (Laban et al.)
finding: ~39% avg drop multi-turn vs single-turn; unreliability not aptitude; do not recover from wrong turn
limitation: underspecified-instruction sharding, not tool loops

title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents (Xiong et al.)
finding: experience-following: errors in retrieved memory propagate; misaligned replay; selective add + deletion +10%
limitation: not tool exposure

title: Latent Preference Modeling for Multi-Session Personalized Tool Calling (PRefine)
finding: existing memory systems often fail to beat full-history prompting; abstracted preference hypothesis wins
limitation: about argument preferences, not tool exposure

title: Mem0 paper
finding: full-context J=72.9 vs Mem0 66.9, p95 17.1s vs 1.4s; >90% token savings; extraction cost excluded
limitation: LoCoMo conversational QA; no independent replication found

title: ToolMem
finding: tool capability memory improves best-tool selection 21-24% on GenAI-Bench/BigGen
limitation: selects among 2 generative tools, not exposure

title: ReMe (procedural memory) / MemSkill
finding: AppWorld SOTA claims for experience memory; MemSkill lowest steps; no token cost or stale-memory study
limitation: numbers not read

title: CLMs 2609.37725 / TraceLab 2606.30560 / dev.to trimming blog
finding: append-only turn avoids 87% compute; edit-at-start 7.7x; TraceLab: cache expiry in human pauses ~12.8% upper bound
limitation: not opened

title: Anthropic multi-agent research system (secondary)
finding: multi-agent ~15x chat tokens
limitation: not opened, not applicable to ~10-step ReAct
